findingVerification.notes: The benchmark warden.toml explicitly sets defaults.verification.enabled = true.

traceCapture.notes: Run used --traces on all six clean shards. Raw JSONL artifacts are withheld pending sensitive-data review; committed traceSummaries retain sanitized per-chunk metadata only.

timing.notes: The host slept during the fifth shard. Recall, findings, token usage, and provider cost remain comparable; wall-clock and per-chunk duration metrics include the idle interval and must not be used for model ranking.

scoring.notes: Agent-verified semantic matches. A finding counts when it identifies the same bug in roughly the same location at the same corpus commit. Same-file findings about different bugs do not count; one finding can map to multiple corpus IDs.

scores.notes: Internal EA features are reachable without the intended org:admin check.
OAuth userinfo accepts tokens tied to inactive users and applications.
Separate secret-redaction gap, not the missing-comma allowlist substring bug.
Separate failed-credential SSO reauthentication path, not the SUPERUSER_ORG_ID fail-open.
Existing members can delete arbitrary organization members without a valid invite token.
Separate force-push race, not the newline-capable filename output injection.
Separate Relay trust and client-IP spoofing issue, not the client_secret_jwt lifetime bug.
Fresh OAuth application client secrets are exposed to non-owner authorization grantees.
Separate timing-unsafe signature comparison, not the Statsig timestamp-freshness bug.
Bitbucket Server accepts unsigned public webhook events.
The legacy unsigned GitHub Enterprise path trusts attacker-controlled host headers.
Discord interaction signatures do not enforce timestamp freshness.
Valid long-lived Jira Server webhook JWTs are written to application logs.
The AWS Lambda integration can resolve cross-organization project key material.
Organization-level Seer RPC methods query project-backed data without project access.
Separate cross-tenant cache-key issue, not either Jira plugin corpus bug.
Copy-as-curl leaves attacker-controlled header names unescaped.
Feature-flag data reaches an unescaped ECharts HTML tooltip; nearby auto-attached locations are not independently evidenced.
Pinned-search PUT mutates another user's organization-visible view without checking ownership.
This is the accept-invite bug represented by the corpus at another commit, not this SHA's same-file slug-confusion entry.
External team update and delete operations resolve mappings by organization instead of the authorized team.
Separate Perforce rsh protocol command-execution issue, not the password-disclosure corpus bug.
Separate Jira key-server and JWT-algorithm issue, not the body clientKey binding corpus bug.
Separate Slack issue-action project authorization gap, not either same-file corpus bug.
Separate Slack Autofix organization-membership gap, not either same-file corpus bug.
Separate team-admin channel unlink issue, not the external_id identity ownership corpus bug.
Preprod artifact approval skips the caller's project-access check.
Any authenticated user can forge the Pub/Sub callback that runs privileged GCP transfer jobs.
Supergroups accepts organization-scoped group IDs without enforcing project access.
Open-period lookup checks organization scope but not project access.
Separate issue-link request host override, not the same-file event JSON project-access corpus bug.
Live Sentry App cell-service callers omit user and bypass project-access checks.
Separate detector-to-workflow attachment gap, not the removed-connection permission corpus bug.
Separate GET secret-redaction gap, not the PUT cleartext logging corpus bug.

notes: Controlled corpus run using Warden 0.47.0 with Pi, openrouter/x-ai/grok-4.6 at high effort for scanning, and openrouter/openai/gpt-5.6-luna at high effort for auxiliary extraction, verification, and merge calls. The benchmark retains its standard maxTurns 100, explicit target lists, and parallelism 4. All 156 chunks completed without repair. The host slept during the fifth shard, so recall and provider cost remain comparable while wall time is contaminated. Raw JSONL artifacts are withheld pending sensitive-data review.
